# MongoDB driver topology discovery and server selection — facts

> Source-anchored units about MongoDB driver topology discovery and server selection: 19 across 3 sources. Each line ends in the URL and anchor it came from; `keywords:` names the lexicon terms that matched.

## Structure and components

- [statement] The load-balancer specification defines an explicit exception: with loadBalanced=true, the topology remains LoadBalanced, contains a single LoadBalancer server description, and starts no monitoring connection. An SRV URI in this mode must not be polled for SRV changes. (low confidence) — https://github.com/mongodb/specifications/blob/master/source/load-balancers/load-balancers.md · keywords: MongoDB driver topology discovery and server selection

## How it works

- [statement] For a primary description whose address is already in the topology, whose replica-set name matches the accepted name or establishes it when unset, and which passes the electionId and setVersion stale-primary checks, SDAM adds previously unknown addresses from its hosts, passives, and arbiters lists and removes servers absent from those lists. An existing-address non-primary description with a matching or newly established replica-set name and no known primary can add members, but does not prune the other members using its host list. (low confidence) — https://github.com/mongodb/specifications/blob/master/source/server-discovery-and-monitoring/server-discovery-and-monitoring.md · keywords: MongoDB driver topology discovery and server selection
- [statement] For a primary description whose address is already in the topology, whose replica-set name matches the accepted name or establishes it when unset, and which passes the electionId and setVersion stale-primary checks, the SDAM algorithm adds previously unknown addresses from its hosts, passives, and arbiters lists and begins monitoring them; it removes servers absent from those lists and stops monitoring them. (low confidence) — https://github.com/mongodb/specifications/blob/master/source/server-discovery-and-monitoring/server-discovery-and-monitoring.md · keywords: MongoDB driver topology discovery and server selection
- [statement] When a new primary is discovered, SDAM marks the previous primary Unknown and requires a multi-threaded client to request an immediate check of that server; it explicitly forbids clearing that old primary's connection pool for this transition. (low confidence) — https://github.com/mongodb/specifications/blob/master/source/server-discovery-and-monitoring/server-discovery-and-monitoring.md · keywords: MongoDB driver topology discovery and server selection
- [statement] Grafana's MongoDB troubleshooting guidance lists unreachable replica-set members as a possible cause of selection failures and recommends making all members reachable, because drivers contact secondaries for discovery. This is troubleshooting guidance, not a rule that any unavailable secondary prevents every operation. (high confidence) — https://grafana.com/docs/plugins/grafana-mongodb-datasource/latest/troubleshooting/?plcmt=products-nav · keywords: MongoDB driver topology discovery and server selection · also: https://github.com/mongodb/specifications/blob/master/source/server-selection/server-selection.md

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] If a write to the known primary fails with a network error other than a timeout, the specification describes marking that server Unknown and changing ReplicaSetWithPrimary to ReplicaSetNoPrimary. An established-connection network timeout alone must not mark the server Unknown. (low confidence) — https://github.com/mongodb/specifications/blob/master/source/server-discovery-and-monitoring/server-discovery-and-monitoring.md · keywords: MongoDB driver topology discovery and server selection
- [statement] Grafana advises checking DNS resolution and reachability of replica-set members when its MongoDB data source reports selection errors; the Databasus issue reporter separately documents discovery of an internal Kubernetes hostname followed by DNS failure and ReplicaSetNoPrimary. (medium confidence) — https://grafana.com/docs/plugins/grafana-mongodb-datasource/latest/troubleshooting/?plcmt=products-nav · keywords: MongoDB driver topology discovery and server selection · also: https://github.com/databasus/databasus/issues/376
- [statement] The TypeORM issue reporter traced a historical connection failure to omission of directConnection from validOptionNames, and later stated that newer TypeORM versions fixed that omission. This report does not establish a current TypeORM defect. (low confidence) — https://github.com/typeorm/typeorm/issues/10023 · keywords: MongoDB driver topology discovery and server selection
- [statement] If multi-threaded server selection finds no suitable server, it requests an immediate topology check and waits for a topology change or the selection timeout; timing out raises a server selection error. (low confidence) — https://github.com/mongodb/specifications/blob/master/source/server-selection/server-selection.md · keywords: MongoDB driver topology discovery and server selection

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] Monitoring behavior is driver-specific: PHP performs monitoring between application operations; the selection specification requires single-threaded drivers to refresh topology during selection rather than through background monitoring. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/php-library/current/tutorial/server-selection.md · keywords: MongoDB driver topology discovery and server selection · also: https://github.com/mongodb/specifications/blob/master/source/server-selection/server-selection.md
- [statement] Single-threaded drivers update topology during server selection rather than monitoring it in the background. With serverSelectionTryOnce true, selection timeouts have no effect and a stale topology or failed first selection triggers a single immediate check; with false, selection loops until success or timeout. (low confidence) — https://github.com/mongodb/specifications/blob/master/source/server-selection/server-selection.md · keywords: MongoDB driver topology discovery and server selection

## Facts and statements

- [statement] The discovery model differs by deployment: one replica-set seed can reveal the other members; a sharded client starts from mongos seeds and may discover additional mongos hosts through SRV polling. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/php-library/current/tutorial/server-selection.md · keywords: MongoDB driver topology discovery and server selection
- [statement] The topology initialization table maps direct connection to Single; with direct connection disabled, a replica-set name yields ReplicaSetNoPrimary, while no replica-set name yields Unknown. (low confidence) — https://github.com/mongodb/specifications/blob/master/source/server-discovery-and-monitoring/server-discovery-and-monitoring.md · keywords: MongoDB driver topology discovery and server selection
- [statement] Receiving a Mongos description changes an Unknown topology to Sharded. A Sharded topology retains Unknown or Mongos descriptions and removes other server types. (low confidence) — https://github.com/mongodb/specifications/blob/master/source/server-discovery-and-monitoring/server-discovery-and-monitoring.md · keywords: MongoDB driver topology discovery and server selection
- [statement] Multi-threaded and asynchronous selection must release an operation once a suitable server is available, without waiting for every server to be discovered. If selection finds no suitable server, it requests an immediate topology check and waits for a topology change or selection timeout. (low confidence) — https://github.com/mongodb/specifications/blob/master/source/server-selection/server-selection.md · keywords: MongoDB driver topology discovery and server selection
- [statement] Load-balanced mode requires a loadBalanced field in the connection handshake; if the server hello response lacks serviceId, the driver must raise an exception that the server does not support this mode. (low confidence) — https://github.com/mongodb/specifications/blob/master/source/load-balancers/load-balancers.md · keywords: MongoDB driver topology discovery and server selection
- [statement] For each server check, SDAM processes the outcome, whether successful or unsuccessful, into a server description and uses it to update the topology description. (low confidence) — https://github.com/mongodb/specifications/blob/master/source/server-discovery-and-monitoring/server-discovery-and-monitoring.md · keywords: MongoDB driver topology discovery and server selection
- [statement] In the SDAM example where a primary is reached through an external IP but advertises only internal IPs, the client replaces the external address with the internal address and temporarily enters ReplicaSetNoPrimary until a primary is available through its topology description. (low confidence) — https://github.com/mongodb/specifications/blob/master/source/server-discovery-and-monitoring/server-discovery-and-monitoring.md · keywords: MongoDB driver topology discovery and server selection
- [statement] For multi-threaded or asynchronous monitoring, selection must unblock once a suitable server is found; the driver must not wait for discovery of all servers to finish. (low confidence) — https://github.com/mongodb/specifications/blob/master/source/server-selection/server-selection.md · keywords: MongoDB driver topology discovery and server selection
